name: specwright
description: Spec-driven development as a few sharp skills, not a framework. Platform-agnostic markdown skills for PRD authoring, vertical-slice cutting, TDD execution in worktrees, and multi-agent review.

skills.name: specwright:grill-me
skills.description: Interview until intent and EARS acceptance criteria are precise enough for specwright artifacts.

skills.name: specwright:grill-with-docs
skills.description: Interview against repository glossary and ADRs, updating CONTEXT.md as decisions crystallize.

skills.name: specwright:tdd
skills.description: Run an intent-based RED-GREEN-REFACTOR loop for one vertical slice.

skills.name: specwright:to-prd
skills.description: Write requirements.md, design.md, and bugfix.md artifacts that match spec-format.md.

skills.name: specwright:to-issues
skills.description: Create beads vertical slices that match slice-schema.md.
